facts.claim: The venue says its indoor and outdoor venues are fully accessible, with ADA-compliant entrances and seating. Accessible, hearing-impaired or visually-impaired seating must be requested when you buy tickets.
quote: The Andrew J Brady Music Center indoor & outdoor venues are fully accessible, offering ADA-compliant entrances and seating. Patrons requiring ADA, hearing-impaired, or visually-impaired seating must specify their needs at the time of ticket purchase .

facts.claim: Seats in the ADA sections are sold on a best-available basis through Ticketmaster or the box office during its hours.
quote: Seating in designated ADA sections is available on a best-available basis. ADA tickets can be purchased on Ticketmaster.com or at the venue box office during operating hours.

facts.claim: Sign language interpretation is available on request at least three weeks before the event, subject to interpreter availability; email info@bradymusiccenter.com.
quote: The Andrew J Brady Music Center offers sign language interpretation upon request. Requests for sign language interpreting services must be received 3 weeks before the event and are subject to availability of an interpreter. Please email info@bradymusiccenter.com with your request.

facts.claim: The FAQ describes three indoor entrances: Race Street, the Tunnel Entrance under the Race Street turnaround, and steps from Mehring Way. The outdoor stage uses the Carousel Entrance on Ted Berry Way.
quote: There are three entrances to The Andrew J Brady Music Center: Race Street Entrance next to the turnaround on Race Street, Tunnel Entrance accessible underneath the Race Street turnaround on The ICON Festival Stage level, and the Mehring Way Entrance accessible by steps from Mehring Way on The ICON Festival Stage level.
There is one main entrance for The ICON Festival Stage at Smale Park: Carousel Entrance on Ted Berry Way near Carol Ann's Carousel.

facts.claim: Service animals covered under ADA regulations are allowed.
quote: Service animals covered under ADA regulations

facts.claim: On November 13, 2026, the FAQ still warns that the garage elevator closest to the venue is out of service. One answer directs visitors to Rosa Parks Street/Ted Berry Way and Freedom Way/Race Street; another names Race Street, Freedom Way and Ted Berry Way separately. Confirm a working route before travel.
quote: The elevator closest to the venue is currently out of service.

There are two elevators, located at the Rosa Parks St. & Theodore M Berry Way Entrance across from the Filson on Ted Berry Way and at the Freedom Way & Race Entrance in front of E+O Kitchen on Freedom Way.
Patrons who need to use an elevator from the Central Riverfront Garage should use one of three elevators: Race Street, Freedom Way, or Ted Berry Way.

facts.claim: Buying ADA-section tickets confirms that someone in the party needs reserved seating because of mobility or standing difficulties. The venue may ask guests in that section to remain seated throughout the event.
quote: By purchasing tickets for the ADA section, you confirm that you or a member of your party requires reserved seating due to mobility or standing difficulties.
To ensure that all guests enjoy an optimal viewing experience, you may be requested to remain seated in the ADA section throughout the event.

facts.claim: The FAQ lists medically necessary bags accompanied by the guest using them as a possible exception to the clear-bag policy; all bags are searched. Confirm arrangements with the venue before attending.
quote: Possible exceptions include: Medically necessary bags and diaper bags accompanied by the guest using them. All bags will be searched.

facts.claim: There is no re-entry at indoor or outdoor events. First Aid is on the Floor by the tunnel entrance, and a gender-neutral bathroom is on the right side of the floor.
quote: There is no re-entry for all indoor & outdoor events.
The First Aid area is located on the Floor by the tunnel entrance.
The venue is equipped with a gender neutral bathroom on the right side of the floor.
